characters.name: The Mogul
characters.text: In secret-bid auctions, your bid counts as $20 higher than it is when bids are compared, and you win ties. You still pay your real bid. When two players roll dice against each other and tie, you win the tie.

characters.name: The Hustler
characters.text: Once per Casino visit, you may reroll your dice (High/Low) or your duel roll (Dice Duel). Once per lap, you may reroll your dice when you roll to move. Your Stadium pick triples rent instead of doubling it.

characters.name: The Commuter
characters.text: Start the game with 3 Momentum tokens instead of 2. Your token limit is 4 instead of 2, and you can Nudge up to 4 spaces (1 token per space).

characters.name: The Lawyer
characters.text: You never pay Jail bail (leaving early is free). When you're sent to Jail, you still collect half the GO salary. You can't be targeted by Audit.

characters.name: The Politician
characters.text: Your City Council vote is worth 250 influence instead of 100, and each dollar you spend lobbying buys 2 influence instead of 1.

characters.name: The City Planner
characters.text: At game start, secretly look at 1 hidden Government tile of your choice. Each time you pass GO, secretly look at 1 more that is still hidden. Once per game, after a City Council vote is rolled, you may reverse the result.

characters.name: The Medic
characters.text: If you're sent to the Hospital, you pay no bill and roll normally on your next turn. Insured markers are free for you (others pay $50).
